run_mask2former_on_images: run mask2former panoptic segmentation on input images using the demo CLI with --input flag
run_mask2former_on_video: run mask2former panoptic segmentation on a video file using the --video-input flag
run_mask2former_on_webcam: run mask2former panoptic segmentation on live webcam feed using the --webcam flag
setup_mask2former_config: setup a detectron2 config object by merging a YAML config file with command-line options
test_opencv_video_format: test whether a given OpenCV video codec and file extension are supported on the system
